**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Parse fullwidth bare amounts after RMB symbols**

Fresh evidence beyond the repaired fullwidth yuan-token cases is that `normalizeMoneyValueV4('￥４０００')` and `normalizeMoneyValueV4('¥４０００')` still return `unsupported` with no amount, although `￥4000` and `人民币４０００` both return exact `4000.00`. The symbol-prefixed token alternative requires a yuan tail, so these unambiguous currency-marked values fall through to the legacy ASCII-only bare-number parser; admit fullwidth digits on this complete symbol-prefixed path.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
